# Bahdan's Toolbox

> Personal site and free bilingual tools by backend engineer Bahdan Hal: Polish employment comparison, technical SEO and GEO audits, and a dated Polish used-goods price index.

## Primary pages

- [About Bahdan Hal](https://bahdan-hal.ovh/): backend work, infrastructure, AI integrations and contact profiles
- [Toolbox in English](https://bahdan-hal.ovh/tools): overview of all tools
- [Toolbox in Polish](https://bahdan-hal.ovh/pl/narzedzia): polska wersja zestawu narzędzi
- [Polish used-goods price index](https://bahdan-hal.ovh/tools/poland-used-price-index): weekly AI-assisted estimates with historical observations
- [Indeks cen używanych](https://bahdan-hal.ovh/pl/narzedzia/indeks-cen-uzywanych): polska wersja indeksu
- [GEO analyzer](https://bahdan-hal.ovh/tools/geo-audit): deterministic generative-engine-readiness checks
- [SEO analyzer](https://bahdan-hal.ovh/tools/seo-audit): technical crawling and indexability checks
- [UoP / UZ / Ud / B2B calculator](https://bahdan-hal.ovh/tools/poland-employment-calculator): Polish contract take-home comparison

## Data access

- Public read-only MCP endpoint: `https://bahdan-hal.ovh/mcp`
- MCP tools list exact tracked product configurations and return dated price history.
- No account or API key is required.

## Important limitations

Used-goods price values are AI-assisted estimates of comparable asking prices, not scraped listings, completed-sale statistics, valuations, or purchasing advice. Marketplace identities, seller data, listing text, and marketplace links are not stored or published.
